list.title: Devices
list.description: Every device the app is used on, managers' phones too. A new device is registered by a manager at its first login.
list.choose: Choose a device from the list.

detail.name: Device name
detail.nameError: Write a name for the device, not too long.
detail.languageHint: The language before login, and for staff who haven't chosen their own.
detail.notFound: This device wasn't found, or you can't see it.

move.title: Move to another branch
move.description: The device works in the new branch and gets a new code there. Only staff of that branch can work on it.
move.confirmDescription: Staff using the device now can't work on it unless they work in that branch.
move.confirmThisDevice: This is this device: from now on it works in that branch.

state.title: Active or not
state.deactivateHint: Nobody can work on a deactivated device, and it doesn't count toward the gym's device limit.
state.reactivateHint: Reactivating counts it toward the device limit again.
state.thisDeviceWarning: This is this device: once it is deactivated, nobody can work here.
state.deactivateDescription: Nobody can unlock or log in on it. You can reactivate it later.
state.reactivateDescription: Staff of its branch can work on it again.
